chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Ja'far ibn Uthman, from Sama'ah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"There is no harm in the night prayer from its beginning until its end, but the best of that is after the middle of the night."
ai.seo_question: What is the best time to perform night prayer according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the temporal flexibility of Salat al-Layl, affirming its validity throughout the night while highlighting the post-midnight period as the peak of spiritual virtue. In Shia jurisprudence, this distinction underscores the emphasis on Tahajjud (night vigil) as a means of drawing closer to Allah during the quiet hours, a practice deeply rooted in the traditions of the Ahl al-Bayt. The ruling reflects the balance between ease in worship and the pursuit of higher spiritual states through dedicated night prayers.
